from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import pytest
from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_business_policy import prepare_reading_business_assessment as prep
from company_wiki.document_understanding import statement_grammar as grammar
from company_wiki.source_catalog.reading_recipe import business_algorithm_hashes

CASES=[
 ('aim-specific-first','We aim to reopen neonatal wards and create value.','support',True,False),
 ('aim-abstract-first','We aim to create value and reopen neonatal wards.','support',True,False),
 ('committed-specific-first','We are committed to treating rare diseases and creating value.','support',True,False),
 ('aspire-or','We aspire to reopen neonatal wards or create value.','support',True,False),
 ('strive-but','We strive to create value but reopen neonatal wards.','support',True,False),
 ('nested-complement','We aim to help clinicians to treat rare diseases and create value.','support',True,False),
 ('chinese-governor-and','公司努力创造价值而且重开新生儿病房。','support',True,False),
 ('chinese-governor-or','公司争取重开新生儿病房或者创造价值。','support',True,False),
 ('direct-product-relative','We aim to supply software that processes customer orders and create value.','support',True,None),
 ('beneficiary-typed-relative','We aim to create value for customers whose products process orders.',None,False,False),
 ('direct-quantity-unresolved','We aim to serve 1200 customers and create value.','unresolved',True,None),
 ('one-vision-not-operation','We aim to create one vision for customers.',None,False,False),
 ('beneficiary-quantity-not-operation','We aim to create value for 300 customers.',None,False,False),
 ('independent-matrix-after-beneficiary-relative','We aim to create value for customers who recycle glass, but we reopen neonatal wards.','support',True,False),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize('case,text,use,relevant,eligible',CASES,ids=[c[0] for c in CASES])
def test_independent_goal_scope(case,text,use,relevant,eligible):
    observed=prep(text,{'relations':[]})
    if use is not None: assert observed.passage.use==use, observed
    else: assert observed.passage.use!='support', observed
    assert observed.passage.relevant is relevant, observed
    if eligible is not None: assert observed.fact.eligible is eligible, observed
    if case=='direct-quantity-unresolved':
        assert observed.passage.reason=='source_goal_quantity_unresolved'
        assert not {'operating_quantity','operating_metric_change','operating_current_state'} & set(observed.fact.reasons)

def test_plain_typed_statement_does_not_load_pos(monkeypatch):
    def unexpected():raise AssertionError('typed non-goal must stay zero POS')
    monkeypatch.setattr(grammar,'_english_tagger',unexpected)
    observed=prep('Our software processes customer orders.',{'relations':[]})
    assert observed.passage.use=='support' and observed.fact.eligible

def test_new_predicate_module_in_actual_recipe(monkeypatch):
    from company_wiki.document_understanding.statement_grammar import predicate_arguments
    owner=Path(predicate_arguments.__file__).resolve();real=Path.read_bytes
    before={pdf:business_algorithm_hashes(pdf_frontend=pdf) for pdf in (False,True)}
    key='company_wiki.document_understanding.statement_grammar.predicate_arguments'
    assert all(mapping[key]==hashlib.sha256(real(owner).replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest() for mapping in before.values())
    def changed(path):
        raw=real(path)
        return raw+b'\n# independent predicate module change\n' if path.resolve()==owner else raw
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path,'read_bytes',changed)
    assert all(business_algorithm_hashes(pdf_frontend=pdf)[key]!=before[pdf][key] for pdf in (False,True))
